results.primary_cause: Evidence supports temporarily elevated dry-bulk freight conditions, but the exact persistence and underlying commodity-volume causality are conflicted by evidence of rerouting-driven strength and prospective oversupply.

supporting_evidence.claim: A key dry-bulk freight-rate measure reached its highest level since December 2023, with Capesize demand and tightening vessel supply cited as drivers.
supporting_evidence.source_title: Dry-Bulk Shipping Rates Hit Two-Year High on Capesize Demand

counter_evidence.claim: BIMCO warned that apparent 2026 dry-bulk strength was substantially artificial from forced rerouting and could reverse into a 2027 supply glut.
counter_evidence.source_title: Dry bulk shipping faces 2027 supply glut: BIMCO warns Hormuz rerouting boost will reverse

counter_evidence.claim: The same BIMCO warning described 2026 market strength as driven substantially by forced rerouting rather than durable underlying demand.
counter_evidence.source_title: Dry Bulk Shipping Faces 2027 Supply Glut: BIMCO Warns Hormuz Rerouting Boost Will Reverse

results.primary_cause: Available sources indicate ongoing storage and NAND-related demand, but they do not provide sufficiently specific, time-consistent evidence for the exact NAND pricing, controller/module demand, and inventory cycle; contradictory direction is unresolved.

supporting_evidence.claim: A 2026 storage and memory conference reported continued market growth and described AI as materially affecting memory and storage demand.
supporting_evidence.source_title: 2026 FMS Shows Storage And Memory Market Continued Growth

counter_evidence.claim: A NAND-controller supplier discussion described changing storage demand but did not establish a broad NAND pricing or inventory-cycle confirmation.
counter_evidence.source_title: Phison Electronics Corp highlights its NAND controller role as demand for storage keeps evolving

counter_evidence.claim: A storage-industry analysis argued that NAND supply may not catch demand in the traditional cycle, but did not establish current industry-wide pricing and inventory conditions.
counter_evidence.source_title: The Next NAND Decade: Why Supply Can’t Catch Demand The Way It Used To
